extra.group_process_cpu_time_scope: process-wide interval for all variants in the transactional group

invocation.privacy_policy: raw argv and filesystem paths are omitted because they may contain credentials or private user paths; reproducibility uses the archived config and its SHA-256

peak_resident_set_size.attribution_note: process-lifetime high-water mark, not a per-run increment; it can include memory peaks from earlier work and concurrent tasks in the same process

process_cpu_time.clock_semantics: sum of current-process user and system CPU time; excludes elapsed sleep
process_cpu_time.concurrency_note: process-wide intervals can include concurrent threads or runs in the same process
process_cpu_time.end_sample_point: immediately after JobController reaches a terminal state
process_cpu_time.scope: process-wide CPU time over the backend execution interval

execution_end.canonicalization: SHA-256 over domain bytes airvortex-source-tree-v1\0, then each file in lexicographic POSIX-relative-path order as uint64_be(path_byte_length), UTF-8 path bytes, uint64_be(content_byte_length), raw content bytes
execution_end.scope: pyproject.toml, top-level run.py/run_gui.sh launchers when present, and regular *.py files below src/airvortex; allow-list excludes outputs, caches, bytecode, tests, documents, and user data

execution_start.canonicalization: SHA-256 over domain bytes airvortex-source-tree-v1\0, then each file in lexicographic POSIX-relative-path order as uint64_be(path_byte_length), UTF-8 path bytes, uint64_be(content_byte_length), raw content bytes
execution_start.scope: pyproject.toml, top-level run.py/run_gui.sh launchers when present, and regular *.py files below src/airvortex; allow-list excludes outputs, caches, bytecode, tests, documents, and user data

source_identity.interpretation: disk boundary hashes identify allow-listed files at two sample points. A match does not exclude a transient edit-and-restore or prove that already imported Python module bytes equal either disk snapshot. A mismatch invalidates a single execution-source identity. Git revisions are reported only when metadata resolves HEAD and are never synthesized
